semantics: Neutral .85 single-GGX with F0=1, height-correlated Smith; alpha is direct NDF slope. This is an idealized passive reflector, not the original coated-conductor P material.
mirror_scope: True camera-side delta sampled exactly. Point-light next-event sampling cannot estimate a delta at the light-side end of a path (caustic connector). Ideal-mirror e2 on the primary panel is valid; ideal-mirror full and h images omit that family and are restricted diagnostics. Do not use the latter as complete physical ground truth.
